steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Set the required event title so publishing can proceed.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Invite one QA vendor as required for the vendor submission.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's technical stage in the vendor portal.
Confirm the RFQ-only clause is not shown on the technical stage.
Confirm the second RFQ-only clause is not shown on the technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should apply.
Confirm the first optional clause is present on the RFQ vendor view.
Confirm the second optional clause is present on the RFQ vendor view.
Submit a quote without accepting any clause, testing that optional terms do not block submission.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the quote.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
